description_sq:
Shesim apartament te tipologjise 2+1 te TIRANA TOWER.
TIRANA TOWER, projektuar nga Oppenheim Architecture, eshte nje kulle 34-kateshe qe kombinon elegancen dhe inovacionin, duke ofruar pamje te jashtezakonshme te qytetit. Çdo kat eshte projektuar per te maksimizuar hapesiren dhe driten, duke krijuar nje ndjenje harmonie dhe lirie.
Fokusi i nderteses eshte bashkejetesa mes natyres dhe qytetit, permes kopshteve te gjelberuara dhe hapesirave te perbashketa qe ofrojne qetesi ne zemer te qytetit.
Fasada unike eshte frymeezuar nga dizajni tradicional i qilimave, duke simbolizuar lidhjen mes historise dhe modernitetit. Perdorimi i betonit te pigmentuar shton nje dimension estetik dhe qendrueshmeri, duke e bere ndertesen nje veper arti.
Tirana Tower eshte nje simbol i aspiratave te qytetit per dizajn modern dhe krijimin e nje komuniteti te bashkuar.
Apartamenti disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 151.6m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 116.6m2. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar koridorin lidhes i cili te con ne dhomen e ndenjes bashke me kuzhinen, 2 (dy) dhoma gjumi 1(nje) tualet dhe ballkon. 
(Ndertimi ndodhet ne faze karabinaje)
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 IN TIRANA TOWER
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment in TIRANA TOWER. TIRANA TOWER, designed by Oppenheim Architecture, is a 34-story tower that combines elegance and innovation, offering exceptional views of the city. Each floor is designed to maximize space and light, creating a sense of harmony and freedom. The focus of the building is the coexistence between nature and the city, through green gardens and common spaces that offer peace in the heart of the city. The unique facade is inspired by the traditional design of carpets, symbolizing the connection between history and modernity. The use of pigmented concrete adds an aesthetic dimension and durability, making the building a work of art. Tirana Tower is a symbol of the city's aspirations for modern design and the creation of a united community. The apartment has a total area of ​​151.6m2 and a net area of ​​116.6m2. The apartment is organized with a connecting corridor that leads to the living room with the kitchen, 2 (two) bedrooms, 1 (one) toilet and balcony. (The building is in the construction phase) For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
